Blocks.Text: The degrees API provides standardized member degree and diploma data across the LinkedIn platform.

Rows.Text: Degree name in various locales. Represented as MultiLocaleString type.
All aliases to this standardized degree name. Represented as an array of MultiLocaleString.
The general standardized degree category for the standardized degree. Represented as a degree URN. Optional.
The locale the degree data is requested in. en_US locale is used if locale is not provided or supported.
A lowercase, two-letter language code as defined by ISO-639.
An uppercase, two-letter country code as defined by ISO-3166.
